integrity: Analytical proof for all ranks with exact finite-matrix corroboration. The previously published upper bound is used with attribution. No independent external audit or proof certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Optimality of the scalar TTO universal bound is proved; no classification of all equality cases or multiband sharpness. Finite checker is not a proof for all ranks; independent mathematical validation not performed. Publication-priority search is nonexhaustive.
title: Sharpness at every rank of the nearly invariant defect bound for truncated Toeplitz perturbations
